instance.basis: FICTIONAL. Protective detail (high credibility, direct observation) reports a small UAS repeatedly holding overwatch positions above the protectee's residence and motorcade staging area, maneuvering to track the detail's counter-surveillance runs — the aerial platform is directly observed (means confirmed). Flight windows have compressed from weekly to daily and now align with the protectee's movement schedule, and a correlated ground vehicle has been logged at or near two consecutive movement sites. Overwatch guiding a present, accelerating ground element against one named protectee conditions the type-medium indicator directly to critical — a two-band raise; the contract requires only that priority never fall below the type band.
